title: Top Ten Challenges to Reach AGI — Stephen Chin, Andreas Kollegger
talk_summary: This is a 4-minute lightning intro to a Graph RAG conference track, structured as a series of sci-fi movie memes (Memento, Skynet, The Matrix, HAL, Terminator, Star Wars, Star Trek, Hitchhiker's Guide) mapped loosely to AGI challenges like prompt engineering, autonomous-system risk, transparency, and oversight. It contains no technical mechanisms, no measured results, and no engineering practices — it is purely a teaser to drive attendance to the Graph RAG sessions.
